title: Observe resolver completion
description: Run the mutation and compare its events with the errors: sync and async failures still record completion. Change quiet to tracing: true and run again to add its events. The reset field clears earlier events each run.
defaultQuery:
mutation Lifecycle {
  reset
  sync
  async
  throws
  rejects
  quiet
  events
}
